stats-descriptive-skew.alt: A histogram of invented data: hours of sleep lost per week for 25 students. Most students lost 1 to 5 hours; a few lost 7, 8, 10 and 12, making a long tail to the right (positive skew). The mode is 3, the median is 4 and the mean is 4.32: the few high values pull the mean toward the tail, past the median.
